items.claim: Uros Medic has a tendency to be involved in first-round knockout fights where he is either the killer or gets knocked out.
items.quote: it's killer be killed for Medic. He's trying to go out there and put you down and he's going to get knocked out in his own right.

items.claim: Uros Medic is significantly faster than Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: I think he's way quicker than D-Rod.

items.claim: Uros Medic possesses more power than Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: I think he's got more power than D-Rod.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez will be too slow for Uros Medic.
items.quote: Drod's just going to be too slow for Medic in my opinion.

items.claim: Uros Medic has a UFC record of seven wins and three losses.
items.quote: Medic UFC career is seven and three.

items.claim: Uros Medic is very hitable and susceptible to being dropped or knocked out early in fights.
items.quote: Medic is very hitable. And I'm a little bit concerned about this with Medic.
